info.title: JavaScript Page to Markdown: Render JS Web Pages + Screenshot
info.description:
Render JavaScript-heavy web pages (React, Vue, Angular, SPAs) in a real Chromium browser and get clean, LLM-ready Markdown with title, metadata and an optional screenshot. Web fetch for RAG and AI agents.

Runs on your own Apify account (pay-per-use). Store: https://apify.com/publicrecords/js-page-to-markdown
MCP: https://mcp.apify.com?tools=publicrecords/js-page-to-markdown
Author: Public Records.
